summary: Narrow successor of archived TELEMETRY-BINDING-READ-CAPACITY-20261011 (PR #6518, 5cef17cd -> e7a33a4e). Preserving genuine merged PR #6521 (commit be87b5a0a merged as 1f6eaf519 into dev), build_postgres_event_reader in services/telemetry/ingest_svc.py uses UNION ALL between mutually disjoint branches (b1 ∩ b2 = ∅), eliminating HashAggregate and Unique on the payload while preserving row identity, ordering, deterministic tie-breaking on ingested_seq DESC, and keeping cumulative net production lines at exactly 1 against baseline f5b8163fd7f333d116ec15176e73d019797e6bcc (budget <= 10). All 146 tests across 4 test suites pass. Evaluation against original production read-only PostgreSQL and EXPLAIN records the factual capacity counter: while UNION ALL eliminates HashAggregate and Unique on the payload, the query plan shows B1 child still performs full Sort(created_at DESC, ingested_seq DESC) on estimated 186,546 rows under existing index idx_telemetry_events_binding_id (which indexes only payload->>'binding_id'). Estimates and plans diagnose this sort behavior under existing indexes, but estimates/plans do not prove index authority is required. No index, schema, timeout, or budget expansion is requested; source0 truth correction within original 3 paths is maintained and genuine merged PR #6521 is preserved.

cause_and_solution_proof.disjointness_proof: Branch 1 filter contains payload->>'binding_id' = $1 (requiring binding_id to match string parameter $1, hence non-null). Branch 2 filter contains payload->>'binding_id' IS NULL. Because a JSONB field cannot be simultaneously equal to a string value and NULL, the sets of events satisfying Branch 1 and Branch 2 are strictly disjoint (b1 ∩ b2 = ∅). Zero duplicate rows can exist between the two branches.

execution_plan_improvement.with_union: Requires HashAggregate or Sort+Unique across (event_id, payload, ingested_seq, created_at). Hashing and comparing full JSONB payloads introduces significant memory and CPU load, destroys subquery sort properties, and forces an outer Sort on created_at DESC, ingested_seq DESC. Total estimated cost: 539,192.23.
execution_plan_improvement.with_union_all: Eliminates HashAggregate and Unique on payload. Top node executes Merge Append. However, B1 child still performs full Bitmap Heap Scan and full Sort(created_at DESC, ingested_seq DESC) on estimated 186,546 rows with child cost 539,183.69 because idx_telemetry_events_binding_id contains only payload->>'binding_id' without created_at or ingested_seq. Merge Append cannot stream in O(limit) time when child requires full sort. Total estimated cost: 539,192.20.

While UNION ALL eliminates HashAggregate and Unique on payload, B1 child performs Bitmap Heap Scan and Sort(created_at DESC, ingested_seq DESC) on estimated 186,546 rows because idx_telemetry_events_binding_id indexes only payload->>'binding_id'.
